summary: Audits a corpus larger than any one context with many agents without inventing findings: a deterministic scout emits a risk-scored wave manifest, a cheap triage pass fans out over slices, an adversarial refute pass kills plausible-but-wrong findings before a human reads them, the aggregator enforces the evidence floor as arithmetic and normalises agent field drift, and nothing is ever applied automatically.

assumes_loaded.why: Defines what counts as evidence; this methodology only enforces that it is present.
The evidence floor and the no-auto-apply rule are both fail-closed gates.
